features.name: debt_to_income_ratio
features.description: Ratio of loan amount to annual income, capturing borrower's debt burden relative to earnings. Higher values indicate greater financial strain.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear signal for repayment capacity; high ratios correlate with default risk and provide clean margin separation for SVM.

features.name: credit_score_normalized
features.description: Credit score normalized to [0,1] range using training set min (418) and max (807) bounds. Higher values indicate better creditworthiness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized credit signal directly usable by linear SVM without scale distortion; strong predictor of repayment behavior.

features.name: interest_rate_normalized
features.description: Loan interest rate normalized to [0,1] using training set min (5.42) and max (20.0). Higher values indicate riskier or more expensive loans.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized interest rate provides smooth continuous signal; high rates often reflect lender-assessed risk and correlate with default.

features.name: income_log_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed income scaled by log of training mean income to reduce skewness. Captures income level on a compressed scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation reduces extreme income outliers, creating a more linear relationship with repayment capacity for SVM margins.

features.name: loan_percent_income_clipped
features.description: Loan percent of income clipped to [0, 0.62] range and scaled. Directly measures what fraction of income goes to loan repayment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Already a ratio feature; clipping removes any anomalies and provides a clean continuous signal for linear decision boundaries.

features.name: credit_history_experience_score
features.description: Composite score combining credit history length and employment experience, both log-transformed and averaged. Measures overall financial maturity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combined maturity signal captures stability dimensions; longer history and experience reduce default risk in a linearly separable way.

features.name: default_history_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the person has previous loan defaults on file. 1 indicates prior defaults, 0 indicates clean history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Strong binary signal for prior default behavior; one of the most direct indicators of future default risk for linear SVM.

features.name: home_ownership_stability_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of home ownership type reflecting housing stability: OWN=3, MORTGAGE=2, RENT=1, OTHER=0. Higher values indicate more stable housing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal housing stability signal; homeowners tend to have lower default rates, providing useful linear margin information.

features.name: education_level_score
features.description: Ordinal encoding of education level: Doctorate=4, Master=3, Bachelor=2, Associate=1, High School=0. Proxy for earning potential and financial literacy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Education level correlates with income stability and financial literacy; ordinal encoding provides smooth linear signal for SVM.

features.name: risk_composite_score
features.description: Weighted composite risk score combining normalized interest rate (weight 0.3), loan percent income (weight 0.4), and default history flag (weight 0.3). Higher values indicate higher risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite risk signal aggregating multiple risk dimensions; weighted combination approximates a linear projection useful for SVM margins.

features.name: loan_intent_risk_score
features.description: Semantic risk score for loan intent based on typical repayment patterns: DEBTCONSOLIDATION=0.8 (high risk, often distressed), MEDICAL=0.7 (emergency-driven), PERSONAL=0.6 (discretionary), VENTURE=0.5 (speculative), EDUCATION=0.3 (investment), HOMEIMPROVEMENT=0.2 (asset-backed). Scores reflect relative default risk by intent category.
features.expected_model_benefit: Loan purpose encodes borrower motivation and repayment likelihood; continuous risk encoding provides smooth signal for linear SVM without one-hot sparsity.

features.name: age_income_stability_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of financial stability combining age and income relative to training distribution means (age mean=27.7, income mean=79417). Scores range from 0 (young, low income) to 1 (mature, high income), with middle-age and moderate income receiving highest scores around 0.7-0.8 to avoid penalizing very high earners.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combined demographic stability signal captures life-stage financial patterns; continuous score provides smooth linear separability for SVM without interaction term complexity.
